author: Dale Philip
description:
I tried Kue Ape which is a traditional Betawi pancake with a soft, fluffy, pandan-flavoured green center surrounded by a wafter-y thin, crispy outer portion.

This is true street food as the only place you can find it is at carts by the side of the road. I've never seen these in restaurants.
title: Legendary Pandan Pancakes in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
